gen-gf-tilt-prism-inter: Tilt Prism draws each glyph with a single-tip simplicity, bold and a little odd, and it shows off best at large sizes. But Inter is the one built for steady reading, with big counters and a smooth, tube-like line.
gen-gf-tilt-prism-mulish: Blocky, bold and quirky up top. Mulish follows in plain sans form, with no thick-and-thin swing, horseshoe-open apertures and a large x-height that makes the whole combination feel friendly.
gen-gf-tilt-prism-rubik: Rubik keeps its lowercase big beside the capitals. Tilt Prism takes the loud, distinctive lead with its one-tip glyphs, while Rubik's soft, open rounds stay readable beneath it without competing.
gen-gf-tinos-fs-bespoke-sans: Tinos has a literary pull, its curves a touch heavier than the joins and its openings wide like a door left ajar. And Bespoke Sans sits against it sharp and refined, with generous room between curve ends and stems.
gen-gf-tiro-bangla-fs-bespoke-sans: Dignified and high-contrast, Tiro Bangla sets fat strokes against slender hairlines with a real tug between them. Bespoke Sans simply steps back, sharp and spacious.
gen-gf-tiro-devanagari-hindi-fs-bespoke-: Tiro Devanagari Hindi pairs sturdy bold strokes with fragile fine ones. Bespoke Sans carries a longer read gracefully, sharp and refined, with generous space between its curve ends and stems, so the lines never feel crowded.
gen-gf-tiro-devanagari-marathi-fs-bespok: Heavy bowls under razor-fine tops give Tiro Devanagari Marathi its bookish, traditional face. And Bespoke Sans offers the plain sans counterweight: sharp, refined, with generous space where curves meet the stem.
gen-gf-tiro-devanagari-sanskrit-fs-bespo: Refined and literary, Tiro Devanagari Sanskrit splits each stroke between bold downstrokes and whisper-thin upstrokes, giving every word a vivid push and pull. Bespoke Sans then reads smoothly and crisply.
gen-gf-tiro-gurmukhi-fs-bespoke-sans: Tiro Gurmukhi sets sharp bright hairline edges against fat dark stems. Bespoke Sans, a refined plain sans with generous space inside its curves, gives those heavy shapes room to stand out.
gen-gf-tiro-kannada-fs-bespoke-sans: Tiro Kannada hangs hairline arms on weighty stems, so the thin parts look almost fragile. Bespoke Sans brings sharp, refined sans-serif precision, with generous space between curve ends and the stem.
